messages.subject: Error in value[[3L]](cond) : invalid multibyte string 1671
parts:
Hello,

I am able to run the app locally.
However, I deployed to ShinyApp.io, I got the following message

Error in value[[3L]](cond) : invalid multibyte string 1671 Calls: local ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous> Execution halted

What does value[[3L]](cond) mean?
What does  multibyte string mean?
and What does 1671 mean? I checked, it is not the line number of my code.

I try to search for an answer but it is not helpful.


Thanks,

Erik

messages.subject: Re: Error in value[[3L]](cond) : invalid multibyte string 1671
parts:
shinyapps.io runs Linux and we attempt to determine the locale you have, but default to UTF-8.
You are likely attempting to read in a file without specifying the encoding to use, and your local system (Windows, to take a wild guess?) is handling this better.
You might get more information, such as a line number, by looking at your application's logs.
